description: غذای کامل گربه بالغ. ترکیبی منحصربه‌فرد از مقاومت بدن و گوارش سالم پشتیبانی می‌کند.
bodyDescription: Optimum immunity and healthy digestion are supported by the addition of a unique blend of dried plants – naturally rich in antioxidants – supplemented with prebiotics and β-glucans. Clinical studies show that plaque and tartar formation are reduced thanks to the added phosphorylated vitamin C. The amount of minerals is tailored to promote good pH and contribute to a healthy urinary tract. Fish oil promotes healthy skin and coat. Vegetable fibre and beet pulp help reduce hairball formation. Formulated without maize or wheat.
